items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 57:1
items.html: Because in direct light the more refined is the more important and the higher, and in reflected light it is the reverse, for the coarser is the more important. Therefore, when they clothe one another, the level of them all turns out to be equal, for the lowest in direct light is the highest in reflected light, and likewise the reverse.
